Vue2 SFC-Composition API <script setup>.description:
Only Vue 2.7 — needs `vue-loader` 15.10+ or `vite-plugin-vue2` 2.2+ to compile `<script setup>`; on Vue 2.6 and below use [unplugin-vue2-script-setup](https://www.npmjs.com/package/unplugin-vue2-script-setup).
Macros available here: `defineProps`, `defineEmits`, `defineExpose`, `withDefaults`.
